name: fable-operating-manual
description: Make any model operate with Claude Fable 5's working discipline. Ships the Fable 5 Operating Manual (reasoning procedures extracted from Fable at peak capability: read intent beneath words, decompose into independently checkable pieces, re-derive every number, label known vs guessed, attack your own conclusion, answer-first reporting), auto-delivered into every session and every dispatched sub-agent via hooks, plus /model-parity-test — a blind 3-arm exam (plain model vs model+manual vs Fable baseline) with trap tests that PROVES how much of the discipline transferred instead of assuming it.
